name: Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints
summary: In Windshear Crag, the Venture Company’s Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints are coveted by goblin rivals. They hold the technical schematics for an enormous mechanized woodcutter deployed in Stonetalon Mountains, designed under gnome engineer Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle’s supervision.

sections.title: Industrial Espionage in Windshear Crag
sections.body: Venture Company operators carry the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints through Windshear Crag. The plans show how to build the massive mechanized lumber harvesters driving the company’s relentless clear-cutting. To the dismay of traditional goblin engineers, the Venture Company put Gerenzo, a gnome, in charge of designing the model. When goblin engineer Ziz Fizziks was ousted from the operation, Sputtervalve quickly hired him to steal the designs. Yet Gerenzo’s dense, eccentric gnomish notations are almost as hard to decipher as the plans are to take by force.

faq.answer: The Super Reaper 6000 is an enormous mechanized woodcutter developed for the Venture Company’s clear-cutting in Stonetalon Mountains.

Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a gnome engineer, designed the plans under the Venture Company’s supervision after being hired to lead its mechanical efforts in Windshear Crag. His appointment annoyed local goblin mechanics.

faq.q: Why does Ziz Fizziks want these blueprints?
faq.answer: After the Venture Company ousted Ziz Fizziks, Sputtervalve hired him to steal the plans. Ziz wants to prove his worth and mechanical genius to his new boss.

faq.q: Who holds the blueprints in Windshear Crag?
faq.answer: Venture Co. operators carrying the physical schematics oversee machinery and clear timber throughout Windshear Crag.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see how Gerenzo’s precise gnomish schematics leave ordinary tinkers baffled, even as goblin corporate muscle puts the machinery to work.
As a gnome, you can see Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle’s ingenuity at work in the blueprints. Even the Venture Company relies on a gnome engineer to design its complex heavy machinery.
